failure_signature: Generator ranks 0-7 remain after DeepSpeed Before creating fp16 partitions; non-Generator ranks 8-15 wait at the outer Gloo control barrier; node0 GPUs spin while node1 GPUs are idle.

root_cause.mechanism: DeepSpeed 0.18.4 ZeRO-3 stage3._create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation calls deepspeed.comm.barrier() without a group at stage3.py:773. In the continuous world16 process graph only ranks 0-7 call deepspeed.initialize, so the bare barrier targets the world16 default NCCL group and waits forever for ranks 8-15. The validated 48.551620-second run launched the eight Generator ranks as their own default world8 and therefore did not expose this mismatch.

bounded_recovery: Route only bare DeepSpeed barriers executed inside subgroup ZeRO-3 initialization to the engine DP8 group, without editing site-packages. First validate with a world4/default-world plus DP2 ZeRO-3 subgroup toy; allow one corrected real16 retry only if that gate passes.
